cues.text: Deep underwater, massive dark roots arch through dim blue water. On the seabed, bioluminescent flora glows in patches of vibrant pink and cool cyan, swaying gently in the current.
A colossal dark creature glides through the gloom. It resembles a smooth, eyeless whale, trailing thin tendrils from its flanks.
A sleek creature resembling a manta ray with a long, whip-like tail swims gracefully past the giant, navigating the tranquil, glowing depths.

beats.note: Deep underwater landscape with massive dark roots and glowing bioluminescent flora.
A large whale-like creature glides into view from the right.
A ray-like creature swims past the larger one, moving towards the center.
